title: Enhanced εr/LD and improved acceptor crystal growth enable all-polymer solar cells with outstanding efficiency, stability, and processability from a chlorinated-dimer diluent additive
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,946-957
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06663H, Paper
Zhiyi Chen, Shanhua Zhang, Rui Sun, Le Mei, Wenyan Yang, Zicheng Xing, Xinrong Yang, Bo Xiao, Xiaohei Wu, Xian-Kai Chen, Jie Min
A chlorinated dimer acceptor (D-SeV-Cl) was designed as a diluent additive for PM6:PYT. Blade-coated all-PSCs using a green solvent achieved a device efficiency PCE exceeding 20%with excellent stability and processability.
